title: One Last Ride — 4:15 Condensed Storyboard Animatic
purpose: Development-only rights-aware visual editorial cut; NOT final animated video, no gameplay footage or recorded dialogue.
music: film/assets/original_teaser_score.wav — repeated temporary original teaser cue, final original soundtrack outstanding
screenplayStatus: The longer 8:30 shot list and extended screenplay remain intact for a potential director's edition.

chapters.title: The last transmission
chapters.caption: A violent impact splits the darkness. Loki calls for Scaly before the story rewinds.

chapters.title: Homecoming on 55th
chapters.caption: Cmac returns. Lupe embraces him. Franklin, CJ and Lamar welcome an old friend.

chapters.title: The Paleto firefight
chapters.caption: Separated by an ambush, Loki and Scaly refuse to leave each other behind.

chapters.title: Every road to the water
chapters.caption: The city's crews converge, shifting from road escape toward the harbor.

chapters.title: Cmac and the Yeti
chapters.caption: An unlikely peaceful moment becomes a chaotic, comic battle. Cmac vanishes.

chapters.title: The last boat out
chapters.caption: Cars stop at the waterfront. Boats carry the crew to safety as Scaly catches Loki.

chapters.title: Our last sunset
chapters.caption: One moment of peace. Many crews. One vision. Los Santos fades beyond the deck.

chapters.title: Into the unknown
chapters.caption: The hull breaks. Two friends disappear into waves; no survival is confirmed.

chapters.title: Leonida, somewhere
chapters.caption: Jason and Lucia find an unexplained artifact. The ocean keeps its secrets.
